points.name: 不仅...而且..., 只有...才..., 只要...就..., 还是...吧
points.explain: These paired conjunctions link two clauses: 不仅 A 而且 B ("not only A but also B"), 只有 A 才 B ("only if A, then B"), 只要 A 就 B ("as long as A, then B"). 还是...吧 at the end of a sentence softens it into a suggestion ("let's just... instead").

sentences.en: He is not only smart but also hardworking.
Only if you go will I go.
As long as you go, I'll go.
